description: This file defines the RouteCollectorProxy class in the Slim Framework, implementing route collection and proxy functionalities, including route definitions, grouping, and redirection.

classes.name: RouteCollectorProxy
classes.description: A proxy class for route collection in the Slim Framework, providing methods for route registration, grouping, and redirection.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns the response factory instance used for creating responses.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the container interface instance, if set.

methods.name: getRouteCollector
methods.description: Returns the underlying route collector instance.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base path for route grouping.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for route grouping.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Defines a GET route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Defines a POST route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Defines a PUT route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Defines a PATCH route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Defines a DELETE route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Defines an OPTIONS route with the specified pattern and handler.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Defines a route that responds to multiple HTTP methods.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps multiple HTTP methods to a route pattern and handler.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a route group with a common pattern.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a redirect route from one path to another with a specified status code.
